title: protium guianense
intro: Protium guianense, commonly known as the 'Guiana tree', is a species of plant in the family Burseraceae. It is a valuable plant in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Protium guianense include the ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat skin conditions like eczema and dermatitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include guaiolic acid, which is responsible for its therapeutic properties, and other compounds like triterpenes and phenolic acids.
